podcast.body: This blues song was recorded by Memphis Mini and her second husband, Joe McCoy, in New York following her discovery by Columbia Records in 1929. The recording serves as an example of her early work in the blues genre. "Here's an example. This is called, Me and My Shofar Blues."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
